name: George Raymond Geiger
biography: Quoted as a laudatory supporter of Dewey who compared Dewey's method to a 'revolution in thought' as stupendous as the industrial revolution, cited by Russell to support his claim that Dewey's philosophy harmonizes with the age of industrialism.
